question: Should maintainers refresh and land this maintainer-labeled Control UI state-ownership refactor once exact-head CI is green?
rationale: The PR has a protected `maintainer` label and no blocking code finding from this read-only review, but ClawSweeper should not close or automate the maintainer-owned landing decision while the branch is behind and exact-head CI is red.

options.title: Refresh and land after green checks
options.body: Update the branch onto current main, rerun exact-head CI, and land the PR if the refreshed checks stay green.

options.title: Request a narrower split
options.body: Ask for the native-link locale fix or the app-shell state cleanup to be split if maintainers want less Control UI surface in one PR.

options.title: Close the candidate
options.body: Close this PR and leave the linked issue open if maintainers no longer want this refactor path.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land after green checks
recommendation.body: Update the branch onto current main, rerun exact-head CI, and land the PR if the refreshed checks stay green.

likelyOwner.reason: This account owns the linked issue and the current maintainer-labeled implementation candidate.
